decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1 The  proposed free standing advertisement sign  would , by reason of   its  position and appearance in relation to a road junction, be a potential road safety hazard and endanger the free flow of traffic and is contrary to the Policies   ENV1.1 (All New Development), ENV1.7 (Advertisements) and T.3.6 (Road Safety) of the Unitary Development Plan and  also Policies ENVB 1.1, (New Development), ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements)  and T4.4 (Road Safety)  of the Revised  Deposit Unitary Development Plan.

2  The proposed advertisement sign would, by reason of its size, position and appearance ,  represent an  intrusive  feature  to the detriment of the visual amenity of the Area of Special Advertisement Control.    The proposal is contrary to the policies ENV 1.7 (Advertisements ), of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of 1 x internally illuminated hoarding sign to site.
